fact: On 27-28 January 2026 a Brazzaville workshop reviewed the RSU as the central targeting tool, noting that it has existed since 2015 under the safety nets but is still insufficiently owned, and that the 2026 work plan funds work on interoperability of national databases; the process for flood-risk neighbourhoods produced birth certificates, national identity cards and unique identification numbers for identifying beneficiaries.
title: Actions sociales : renforcer l'assistance aux personnes vulnérables grâce au RSU
